in_marathi.name: Kharadi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kharadi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kharadi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kharat' which means 'Bend' or 'Curved'. The name signifies a river bend or a curve in a river. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and symbolizes the cyclical nature of life.
